standard_sequential_reduction.native_scope: Metadata/monitor reading, one shared instrument-geometry construction, per-run mask/charge setup and event conversion; detector reverse-mapping and NPZ export excluded. This is not a fresh all617 isolated-reduction time.
standard_sequential_reduction.estimate_scope: One sequential external process, up to64 internal threads. Selected runs are not a random sample; final merging/saving additional. Full617 Mantid reduction was not rerun.

definitions.per_cell: All C,V,count,N cells; intensity and sigma only on common N>0 support. No additional exposure cutoff; maximum relative differences omit only zero reference values.
definitions.pooled_h_energy: Sum C,V,count,N over K and L, then C/N and sqrt(V)/N; independent-copy variance convention.
definitions.coverage_fringe: Pooled Mantid N>0 within two 8-connected dilation steps of N=0 inside the grid.
definitions.low_exposure_decile: Bottom decile of positive pooled Mantid N independently in each energy column >=3.5meV.
definitions.uncertainty_roi: Pooled H111 .13..23 r.l.u., E3.5..25meV, Mantid N>0.

definitions.fine_low_exposure_decile: Bottom decile of all positive individual4D Mantid exposures at E>=3.5meV; exact empiricalquantile, no extra exposure cutoff.
definitions.fine_coverage_fringe: Positive individual4D Mantid N within two axis-neighbor steps of N=0, excluding artificial zeros outside grid.
definitions.extrema_neighborhood: One bin each side along each axis; histogram-only diagnosis cannot identify individual contributing trajectory spans.

zoom_recipe.selection_note: Nearest-center endpoints are inclusive in the existing viewer: K−.03…+.03 selects7 cells and L.31… .35 selects5. E plot limit−2.915 is not a binning edge. Primary validation uses unsubtracted NiO and explicit requested12 operations.
zoom_recipe.saved_generator_comparison_scope: Same-MDE native-only comparison using the saved sample-owned generators. This does not validate those non-permutation operations against Mantid or establish which symmetry is physically appropriate.

limits: OS caches uncontrolled and JIT may affect first dispatch. Jobs were sequential;64 engine threads,1BLAS thread.
Counts, numerator and variance equality must be checked per-cell. Exposure is not bitwise equal.
No additional tiny-exposure cutoff; ratio comparisons omit zero reference values and I/sigma use common positive-N support.
Independent-copy variance matches Mantid diagonals but omits cross-bin symmetry covariance. Within-bin correction is explicit and is not full covariance.
Zero observed count variance is the conditional plug-in convention, not a statement that an empty covered cell has zero physical uncertainty.
These maps/profiles pool additive C,V,N before normalization; they do not validate every existing viewer or arbitrary generic estimator.
Vanadium/normalization calibration uncertainty is not measured here.
No main project was saved. Raw temporary caches are process-owned and cleaned after validation.
